text: 会议指出，要以基层为重点建强医疗康复护理服务体系，推动康复护理资源向社区、家庭延伸，增强城乡居民康复护理服务可及性。要依靠科技创新提升医疗康复护理水平，开发更多智能康复技术和设备，优化新技术新产品审评审批，丰富服务场景。要强化医疗康复护理支持保障，动态调整康复医疗、长期照护服务项目目录，深化医疗康复护理服务价格改革，完善人才培养政策，不断增强职业吸引力。（央视新闻）
text_en: The meeting pointed out that it is necessary to focus on the grassroots level to build a strong medical rehabilitation and nursing service system, promote the extension of rehabilitation and nursing resources to communities and families, and enhance the accessibility of rehabilitation and nursing services for urban and rural residents. It is necessary to rely on scientific and technological innovation to improve the level of medical rehabilitation and nursing, develop more intelligent rehabilitation technologies and equipment, optimize the review and approval of new technologies and new products, and enrich service scenarios. It is necessary to strengthen support and safeguards for medical rehabilitation and nursing, dynamically adjust the catalog of rehabilitation medical and long-term care service items, deepen the price reform of medical rehabilitation and nursing services, improve talent training policies, and continuously enhance the attractiveness of the profession. (CCTV News)
